notes.title: Localization Update Out Now
notes.content:
Hey Retropolis Fans!

Exciting news! Just a month after our launch, we're rolling out Update 0.68 for "Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye". Here's what's new:

🌍 Language Localization: We've gone global! The game now supports:
* Spanish
* Italian
* German
* French
* Korean
* Japanese
* Hebrew
* Enjoy the game in your preferred language!

🐞 Bug Fixes: Alongside, we've squashed some bugs to enhance your gameplay experience.

Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more updates!
Happy Gaming!
Asaf from Peanut Button

notes.title: Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye - Hotfix Release Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Retropolis Community!

First and foremost, we want to express our immense gratitude for the incredible support and feedback you've shown since the launch of Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye. Your enthusiasm and dedication have been nothing short of inspiring.

[b]What's New in This Hotfix:[/b]
We're excited to announce a hotfix that addresses the key issues you've helped us identify over the first weekend. Here's what we've fixed:

*[u]Game Crash at Electricity Puzzle (Episode 4):[/u]
We've identified and resolved the issue causing the game to crash during the electricity puzzle in Episode 4. You should now be able to solve the puzzle without any interruptions.

*[u]First-Person Head Model Visibility:[/u]
In some scenes, players reported seeing the first-person's head model from within. This has been fixed, ensuring a seamless and immersive gaming experience.
Other Minor Fixes:
Alongside these major fixes, we've also squashed some smaller bugs to enhance overall game performance and stability.

[b]We Need Your Help![/b]
Our journey doesn't end here! We rely on your feedback to make Retropolis 2 the best it can be. If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions for improvement, please don't hesitate to share them with us.

[b]How to Share Your Feedback:[/b]
Steam Community Forums: Join the discussion and share your thoughts on our official Steam Community page.
Reach us directly: Shoot us a message at our discord server, on our website, or in our designated support email.

Thank you for being a part of the Retropolis community. Your support and feedback are the cornerstones of our development process, and we're committed to providing you with the best gaming experience.

Happy gaming, and best regards,
The Peanut Button Team.

notes.title: 📣 Developer Update: Retropolis 2 Release Date Announcement! 🚀
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community,

Get ready for an adventure like no other! We're thrilled to announce that Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye is coming in full force to Steam for all PCVR owners to enjoy.

🗓️ Release Date: January 18th, 2024 - Just One Week Away!
Mark your calendars and prepare to step into the world of Retropolis on January 18th. Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative, captivating environments, and a city of robots waiting to be explored.

🎬 New Trailer Unveiled!
To heighten the anticipation, we've released a brand-new trailer that gives you a glimpse into the thrilling sequel. Watch now and get ready to unravel the mysteries that await in Retropolis 2.

[previewyoutube=8MK9w2JrUcI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Spread the word, share the excitement, and get ready to experience Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye on Steam in just one week!

See you in Retropolis,

The Peanut Button Team <3
